name: Bifurcation Diagram
desc: The logistic-map fig-tree fractal: a single line forking to 2, 4, 8 and cascading into a chaotic haze shot through with periodic windows, hued cool where stable and hot where chaotic, a phosphor scan-bar sweeping the r-axis while the window slowly pans and zooms into self-similar detail.

zoom.doc: magnification into the r-window (higher = deeper self-similar detail)

glow.doc: orbit-density exposure / brightness of the attractor

density.doc: orbit points iterated per column (richness of the haze)

hue.doc: cool (stable) palette anchor; hot end derived from it

x.doc: pan the r-window center along the cascade

y.doc: vertical shift of the attractor axis
